title: Geometry tab: at the default window size a face row's label is cut off and its remove button is out of reach

labels.name: claimed
labels.description: An agent is working on this - see the claim comment

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body: ### Where Operation dialog (properties panel, tabs, fields) ### Kind of problem Something does not work (broken) ### What happened, and what you expected At the window's default size, a selection row in an operation's Geometry tab can be wider than the Properties panel, and the panel cuts it off at its right edge. A face row is the widest, because it starts with two buttons, "Set origin" and "Set origin (Z only)". Its label is cut off ("Face first-p…"), and its × (remove this pick) button is past the edge, so you can't see it or click it without widening the panel. A vertex row loses the end of its coordinates the same way ("Vertex first-part · (30.00, 15.00, …"). Expected: every row's label and its × fit in the panel at the default size. A long label can be shortened, with the full text on hover, but the × should always be visible and clickable. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Start CamCraft at its default window size (1280 × 832 points here) and import `examples/models/first-part.obj`. 2. Add a 3D Pocket on it, and in its Geometry tab pick the boss's top face, one of its top edges and one of its top corners. 3. Look at the Face row: its label is cut off at the panel edge, and its × is not visible. ### Screenshots or recording From the hand-check on #1507, at the default size: the Face row at the top of the list ends at "Face first-p", and the Vertex row at "(30.00, 15.00,". The Chain row is short enough to keep its ×. ### How it should work (optional) In `crates/ui/src/egui_app/geo_page.rs`, `chips` lays each row out as one `ui.horizontal`: the row's buttons, then the label, then the ×. Two ways to keep the × reachable would be to put the × first, or to give the label the space that's left after the buttons and the ×, shortened with the full text on hover. The row-hover highlight from #1520 covers the whole row, so either way it keeps working. ### camcraft version, OS and screen Built from `main` at 4f4edcf3 (the window shows v0.19.0), macOS on Apple silicon, Retina display, window 1280 × 832 points.
